task.title: Filter corpus samples by verification status
task.objective: Select records containing an exact passed, failed, or not-run verification while preserving complete validation and deterministic sampling
acceptance_criteria: The option accepts exactly passed, failed, or not-run
A record matches when at least one verification has the requested status
Records without verification entries do not match
Filters compose conjunctively and limits apply after filtering

attempts.summary: Added focused regressions for every status, empty verification lists, composition, and failure semantics
attempts.diagnostic: Clap rejected the unimplemented verification-status option

attempts.summary: Added a typed CLI value and exact existential matching over validated verification entries

outcome.summary: Deterministic corpus sampling supports exact per-check verification-status selection

lessons: Typed CLI values keep schema enums and command spelling aligned
Existential status matching naturally excludes records without verification entries
